conditions: Derivative-free seeded bounded search (LHS fill + coordinate refinement); no global-optimality claim is made.
Chance constraints are expressed on the spec's declared confidence-level band edges (normal/conservative); they are not posterior probabilities over model error.
Batch campaign only: per-candidate band propagation cost rules out interactive latency until the persistent-worker item ships.
Winner re-verification is a same-process re-solve (identical code path), not an independent implementation.
